title: Codex Chrome / Browser Use allowlist issue
description: Enterprise network policy blocks access to specific domains during automated browser sessions. Blocked hosts: https://substack.cpf-coaching.com, https://vcisobriefing.substack.com, https://login.buffer.com, https://publish.buffer.com. Workarounds are forbidden by the tool once this policy is triggered.
